description: Check the user's Show & Tell day: whether today's word is played, their streak, whether the streak is at risk, and when the next word unlocks. Use it for check-ins and for daily reminders the user asked you to schedule. With mode "go" it checks Get Out & Go instead: whether today's list is open, how far along they are, and after 9 p.m. their results and the photobomb. With a challenge code it checks that friends challenge: who's in, who's done, and the board once it's out. Without one, the daily status also lists the user's challenges in play.

challenge.description: A friends challenge code, like "K7QFX", when this call is for that challenge instead of the daily word.

mode.description: "go" for Get Out & Go: five words hiding outside, one at each star. "courses" for Courses: a run at a real place, five words written for it, on a clock. Leave it out for the daily word.

player.description: The player code from start_round, e.g. "brave-otter-4821". The same code in every chat keeps the streak going.

timezone.description: The user's IANA timezone, e.g. "America/Los_Angeles". Always send it when you know it: the day changes at the user's local midnight, and Get Out & Go runs from 6 a.m. to 9 p.m. on their clock. Ask for their city if you don't know.

name: get_status
title: Check Show & Tell status
